paired_budget_design: Use the exact same ten inputs and row_ids at each budget; hold decoding and prompt constant across budgets.
selection_algorithm: For each computed_hop=1..5, sort Primary test rows by SHA256 UTF-8 of stage-b2-3-budget-pilot|20261013|<computed_hop>|<integer row_id>, breaking ties by integer row_id; take the first two.
content_hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON of {row_id,computed_hop,canonical_relation,story,question}; ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon); story is an array, row_id and computed_hop are integers. Hash excludes hash/digest fields.
inference_boundary: Equal-hop diagnostic sample, not representative of the natural 2063-row Primary distribution; ten items support completion, memory and runtime diagnostics, not reliable population accuracy estimates.
notes: No filter based on previous correctness, parseability, length, or truncation was applied.
canonical_relation is frozen gold metadata and must not be included in the model prompt.
A five-entry story denotes five relation statements; some statements contain more than one grammatical sentence.
